card.name: Linking words in combination products
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "a" or "the" right after a component of a two-part or paired thing, such as the "component of" a combination drug. Also fires partway through names of combination ingredients.

modes.label: After "component"
modes.description: The word "of" right after "component" in a fixed-dose combination product.
